title: Chapter 17: Revitalizing Spirit Water
paragraphs: After class, Chen Mobai didn't lag behind. Relying on his faster Lightness Technique—now that his Qi Refinement stage had stabilized—he secured a spot in the first batch of Cultivation Chamber slots.
He needed to verify as soon as possible whether the fish was responsible for the unusual ripples in his otherwise smooth cultivation.
During his two hours in the Cultivation Chamber, he didn't waste a moment. He diligently studied the email Chan Si had sent him.

True to her word, now that he had the complete "Detailed Explanation of the Azure Water Formation," Teacher Chan hadn't disappointed him. After thoroughly comprehending the material herself, she had prepared a detailed instructional presentation, breaking down the second-tier formation into its five fundamental components: Spirit Gathering, Concealment, Complexity, Water Control, and...
Having personally worked with the Azure Water Formation, Chen Mobai easily immersed himself in the material.

By comparing his recent hands-on experience with the Array Flags to the presentation's meticulously detailed explanations, his understanding of this second-tier formation suddenly advanced from novice to initiate.
The two hours passed quickly.
An alarm startled Chen Mobai awake from his immersed study.
"Teacher Chan can actually explain things so clearly!" he muttered to himself.

Muttering to himself, Chen Mobai recalled Chan Si's habitually dry and monotonous lectures, completely oblivious to the fact that he himself had never been particularly interested in the subject matter.
Humans are all the same—even cultivators, if they're truly passionate about something, will stay up all night to figure it out.
Rising to his feet, Chen Mobai stretched lazily and glanced around before suddenly freezing in place.
As if blessed by extraordinary luck, Yan Bingxuan emerged from the Cultivation Chamber to his left.

After a few days apart, the class beauty's aura seemed even more frosty than before, likely due to her formal cultivation of theFrost Condensation Method, which had begun transforming her Spiritual Root into ice.
Meanwhile, from the Cultivation Chamber to his right emerged Song Zheng, another prodigy in their class.
Having missed the first round of spots in the second-tier Cultivation Chambers, he had probably settled for the first-tier chamber as a temporary measure.
Chen Mobai wasn't part of their circle and didn't know how to greet them.
After an awkward silence, Song Zheng finally spoke first.

"Yan Bingxuan, I still believe you've made the wrong choice. With your talent, if you had focused solely on advancing your cultivation and studies this semester, you could have at least qualified for the entrance exams of the Four Great Dao Academies. You might even have leapt like a carp through the dragon gate, soaring to unprecedented heights."
Song Zheng completely ignored Chen Mobai, addressing Yan Bingxuan directly with a calm expression.
"Summer insects cannot comprehend ice!"
To this, the increasingly icy Great Beauty Yan responded with an idiom that made Song Zheng's brow furrow and nearly lose his composure.

"I've inherited Teacher Ding's legacy and have the means to transform my Spiritual Root into the Three Yang Constitution. However, I believe my potential far exceeds the Pure Yang Palace. Only the Four Great Dao Academies are worthy of my ambition."
Song Zheng's words silenced Chen Mobai.
This guy's confidence is blinding.
If he could even get into the Pure Yang Palace—one of the Ten Great Palaces—his mother would brag about it to the neighbors for the rest of her life.
Yet Great Beauty Yan, ever stingy with her words, replied with another idiom:
"A frog at the bottom of a well!"
Song Zheng's anger was barely contained.
Chen Mobai glanced at the time. Without acknowledging the two ignoring him, he slipped between them to leave.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk... I bet they'll settle this at the stadium later."

Before Chen Mobai could leave, his deskmate Lu Hongsheng grabbed him. Soon, a circle of classmates had gathered around them, all watching Song Zheng, his fists clenched, as he challenged Yan Bingxuan to a duel of spells.
Fighting and brawling were strictly prohibited within the school.
However, the exchange of spells was actively encouraged.
Academic elites often used these exchanges as an excuse to prove who was the strongest among them.
"I have some errands to run today, so I'll be leaving early. Let me know the outcome of their exchange later."

Although Chen Mobai was eager to witness the clash between the class's only two Late-Stage Qi Refinement elites, he reconsidered his evening plans and decided not to waste his precious time spectating.
Lu Hongsheng's attention was entirely focused on the two academic elites, and he absentmindedly grunted in response. By the time he realized what was happening, Chen Mobai had already vanished.
"That kid's been acting strange lately."
"Yeah, he's always the first to bolt after cultivation sessions."
"Could he be seeing someone?"
The two beautiful girls at the desk in front of Lu Hongsheng exchanged knowing glances, sending a sudden jolt of realization through him.
"Let's go! Great Beauty Yan agreed!"
Before they could delve further into the matter, Yan Bingxuan turned with a cold smile and strode toward the stadium.
Spell exchanges, to prevent damage to the surroundings, were always conducted in areas within the school protected by magical Restrictions.
The stadium was one such place.
After rushing out of the school, Chen Mobai immediately put the trivial incident out of his mind.
On his way home, he spotted a pharmacy and went inside.
The pharmacy wasn't large, but it was relatively well-stocked. Strangely, there was no one behind the counter.
Chen Mobai had to wander around himself, looking for what he needed.
"Hello? Is anyone here?"
After searching the entire store, he still couldn't find any Spiritual Power Test Strips for simple attribute measurement. He called out loudly toward the back door.

A crisp reply rang out, and the back door slid open. A young woman dressed in white clothes and pants, her hair tied up beneath a white cap and mask, emerged. Though only half her face was visible, her pitch-black, luminous eyes, brimming with captivating charm and Spiritual Energy, immediately drew him in.
He had never seen such clear, pure eyes before, as immaculate and flawless as her pristine white attire.
"Welcome, sir. What can I help you with?"
"Where are the Spiritual Power Test Strips? I can't find them."
"Just a moment. They're in the cabinet. I'll get them for you."
The white-robed girl's features were exquisitely delicate, her skin as white as snow. With the added allure of a face mask, Chen Mobai couldn't help but glance at her more than once as they spoke.

After their exchange, the girl turned and walked toward the counter by the door. Her slender figure was graceful, but the faint medicinal scent wafting from her made Chen Mobai frown and cover his nose with his fingers.
He had been seriously ill as a child and had taken medicine for years, so he had developed an aversion to medicinal odors.
"How many strips would you like?"

The white-robed girl approached with an opened box of Spiritual Power Test Strips. At that moment, she noticed Chen Mobai's right index finger pressed against his nose, her dark, bright eyes widening in momentary surprise.
"Five strips will do, thank you," Chen Mobai replied, using his other hand to select five strips from the box she held. He quickly walked to the door to scan the QR code for payment.

"I apologize," the girl's voice came from behind. "I was refining Return Origin Spiritual Water back there, and my extraction technique wasn't quite up to par, so I'm still carrying a strong medicinal scent."
Chen Mobai turned to see her standing in place, not following him, her eyes filled with apology.
"Oh, you're a Pill Refiner?" he asked.
Immortal Sect regulations stipulate that only those who have passed the Pill Refiner certification exam are permitted to refine medicines.
While there are various methods for refining Medicinal Pills, the most prevalent technique on Diyuan Star remains Water Method Pill Refining.

Fire Method Pill Refining tends to vaporize some of the medicinal materials' Spiritual Energy, leading to waste. In contrast, Water Method Pill Refining emphasizes extraction, achieving high efficiency and producing milder medicinal properties. Most Water Method-refined elixirs, whether taken orally or injected, not only act swiftly but also typically leave no lingering side effects.
Return Origin Spiritual Water is a first-tier medicinal liquid that can be taken orally to restore Spiritual Power to cultivators in the Qi Refinement stage.
